title: Welcome to WaveStrap 1.0
body: Cursor themes, mod packs, profiles and official-installer repair are all in. Pick a profile on Home to get started.

title: Only Roblox-allowed client settings
body: Roblox limits which client flags it reads. WaveStrap only writes flags on that list, so nothing is silently ignored.

title: Make your own mod packs
body: A mod pack is a ZIP with a wavestrap-mod.json and a files/ folder. See docs/ADDING_FEATURES.md in the repository.
